title: Clinical Negligence Paralegal
description:
Clinical Negligence Paralegal / 1+ Years' Experience / Merseyside / c£28,000 / An excellent opportunity for a Clinical Negligence Paralegal to join an established and supportive team, assisting with a varied caseload of clinical negligence claims while developing your legal experience and playing an important role in supporting clients through the claims process - To apply please call Teagan on and quote Job Ref: 6089

JOB TITLE: Clinical Negligence Paralegal
PQE REQUIRED: 1+
LOCATION: Merseyside
SALARY: Up to £28,000 (DOE)

THE ROLE:
You will join an experienced medical negligence team, working alongside other Paralegals and Solicitors to support claims from initial enquiry through to investigation.
A key part of the role will involve handling new enquiries, carrying out initial investigations into potential claims and acting as an early point of contact for clients. You will discuss funding options, prepare risk assessments, obtain and review medical records, draft witness statements and assist with instructing medical experts.
You will also manage your own caseload of new enquiry claims, undertake legal and quantum research, prepare correspondence and court documentation and support Solicitors with the progression of their wider caseloads. Regular liaison with clients, medical experts and third parties will be an important part of the position, alongside keeping track of appointments, deadlines and case progression.

THE CANDIDATE:
The successful candidate will have previous Paralegal experience, ideally with at least 1 years' experience within clinical negligence. You should have a good understanding of the claims process and be confident dealing with clients, reviewing documentation and assisting with the preparation of legal cases.
You will be highly organised, with strong communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines. A professional and empathetic approach to client care is essential, alongside a proactive attitude and genuine enthusiasm for developing your legal knowledge and experience.

THE FIRM:
You will be joining an established law firm that places real importance on teamwork, support, guidance and continued learning. The firm promotes a collaborative working environment where colleagues are encouraged to share knowledge, develop their skills and contribute to the success of the wider practice.
The role offers 20 days' annual leave, increasing to 25 days after five years' service, plus bank holidays and three additional days over the Christmas closure period.
Additional benefits include hybrid working after probation, birthday leave, paid sick leave, dependant's leave, Medicash healthcare scheme, discounts on legal services, employer supported volunteering, wellbeing and social events, bonus and recognition schemes and regular performance and salary reviews.

HOW TO APPLY:
Contact Teagan Portas at eNL on / or email with your CV, or simply call for a confidential discussion.

eNL will never share your CV with a third party without your express permission. As part of our candidate care process, we aim to respond to all applications in 7 days. If you have not been contacted within this timescale, your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. Please note our advertisements use PQE/salary levels purely as a guide.

At eNL we value diversity and inclusion. We want to attract people at all levels and encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates whatever your ethnicity, religion, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any characteristics protected by law in the jurisdictions in which we operate.

title: Corporate Paralegal
description:
Corporate Paralegal

Location: Liverpool

Working Pattern: Full-Time - Hybrid working arrangemnt

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

An exciting opportunity for an aspiring Corporate Paralegal!

We are currently working with a prestigious and well-established law firm who are looking to recruit a motivated and detail-oriented Corporate Paralegal to join their busy and growing Corporate team in Liverpool.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a genuine interest in Corporate law to gain exposure to high-profile transactions and work alongside leading legal professionals, supporting some of the world's most recognised businesses.

Whether you are a recent Law graduate looking to take the next step in your legal career or an experienced Paralegal looking to develop your expertise within Corporate law, this role offers excellent exposure, ongoing training and the opportunity to work on a varied range of matters.

The Role

As a Corporate Paralegal, you will provide essential administrative and legal support to Partners, Associates, Trainees and fellow Paralegals across a variety of corporate transactions and projects.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Providing legal and administrative support on a wide range of corporate matters and transactions.
- Assisting with high-profile and complex corporate deals, as well as day-to-day transactional support.
- Preparing and managing transaction documentation, including execution and post-completion matters.
- Conducting pre-completion searches and assisting with Companies House filings.
- Supporting due diligence processes, document verification and legal research.
- Preparing, collating and maintaining transaction bibles and ancillary documentation.
- Setting up and managing electronic data rooms.
- Assisting with document preparation, execution and completion processes.
- Working collaboratively with colleagues across different practice areas and jurisdictions.
- Managing competing priorities and ensuring deadlines are met to the highest standard.

About You

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- A Law degree (2:1 or above), GDL, or previous relevant Paralegal/CILEX experience.
- A genuine interest in Corporate law and a desire to develop within this area.
- Previous legal experience would be advantageous, although full training will be provided.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- The ability to work effectively under pressure and manage competing deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- A proactive, flexible and adaptable approach, with the ability to use initiative.
- The confidence to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
- Good IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Flexibility to support cross-jurisdictional matters and different time zones when required.

An interest in emerging technology, AI and legal tech platforms would also be highly advantageous.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
- Full-time, permanent opportunity.
- The opportunity to work within a highly regarded Corporate practice in Liverpool.
- Exposure to high-profile, complex and international transactions.
- Excellent training and development opportunities.
- The chance to work alongside experienced Partners and leading legal professionals.
- A collaborative and supportive working environment.
- Opportunities to develop your legal career within a prestigious firm.

Interested?

If you are a Law graduate or an aspiring Corporate Paralegal looking to build your career within a leading legal practice, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Natalie Dwan at LJ Recruitment for a confidential discussion about this exciting opportunity.

All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

title: paralegal
description:

The successful candidate will provide legal and administrative support to solicitors and fee earners, assisting with case management, legal documentation, client communication and the day-to-day running of legal matters.

- Preparing, drafting and reviewing legal documents and correspondence.
- Conducting legal research and summarising findings where required.

- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring documents are completed and submitted on time.

The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable and enthusiastic about developing their legal career. They will have a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn and the ability to support a busy legal team effectively.

How to Apply

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.

title: Trade Mark Paralegal
company: The Law Support Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Trade Mark Paralegal

A highly regarded international IP practice is growing its trade mark team and needs an experienced paralegal to help look after a large, international portfolio.

The role is hands-on and has real influence. You will be responsible for getting filings in correctly, keeping deadlines on track and making sure records are reliable across many jurisdictions. You will work alongside partners, attorneys, associates, clients and overseas agents, and handle a wide mix of trade mark and design paralegal work that underpins clients' worldwide trade mark plans.

You will report to the Trade Mark Paralegal Manager and join a supportive team working across UK offices. The firm's clients include some of the best-known brands in the world.

What you'll be doing
- Filing UK, EU, international and national trade mark and design applications, accurately and within deadline.
- Overseeing key dates and portfolio records so that every procedural step is completed promptly.
- Being the go-to contact for clients, fee earners and overseas agents, keeping matters moving and giving straightforward updates.
- Handling assignments, recordals, searches, portfolio reports and official correspondence for a broad range of countries.
- Keeping client data accurate through careful portfolio management, reporting and database upkeep.

What you'll bring
- A minimum of two years in a trade mark role, preferably in private practice.
- Sound knowledge of UK and international trade mark and design procedures, and the confidence to run matters on your own.
- Hands-on experience with an IP records management database.
- A meticulous approach and a history of producing accurate work under pressure while juggling priorities.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with clients, colleagues and overseas contacts.
